name: Mexico
summary: North American nation with mountainous plateaus and tropical coastal lowlands. Valley of Mexico thermal inversions trap urban smog while northern arid regions suffer recurrent drought.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 3.96x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); high altitude and mountain basin topography trap vehicular emissions in Mexico City.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; second warmest calendar year recorded by SMN.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: Linear warming rate across northern and central Mexican meteorological stations over 1994-2023.

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 1.3% share of global fossil emissions; transport and domestic oil and gas refining drive national total.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Below world average per capita rate; industrial energy efficiency expanding in northern border manufacturing hubs.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Contains ~653,000 km² of temperate pine-oak and tropical deciduous and evergreen forests.

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Hydropower (8.6%), utility solar (6.8%), and onshore wind (6.5%) alongside significant geothermal capacity.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Arithmetic population density of 66 people/km²; urban population fraction is 81.3%.
